Strategy: Dual-ratio band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals whose ratio to the item rounds to one or two score far lower, while other residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit leaves a residual near one or two item sizes while a looser bin avoids both bands. It may help by avoiding two common awkward leftover sizes at once, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 200.0 if round((r - item) / item) == 1 or round((r - item) / item) == 2 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Dual-ratio band avoidance: penalize residual with round(rem/item) in {1,2} by 200, exact fit highest.
